AMENDED AND RESTATED BYLAWS OF KRUSCH ENTERPRISES INC.

Article I: Stockholders and Governance
Section 1.1 Annual Meeting
The annual meeting of stockholders shall be held on the third Tuesday of May each calendar year.

Section 1.2 Special Meetings
Special meetings of the stockholders may be called only by the Chairman of the Board or Chief Executive Officer.

Article II: Board of Directors
Section 2.1 Number and Qualifications
The Board shall consist of not less than five (5) nor more than nine (9) directors.

Section 2.4 Quorum and Voting
A majority of the total number of authorized directors shall constitute a quorum for the transaction of business.
